title: Hadamard-power generalized Cauchy–Schwarz conjectures
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, every real $p\geq 2$, and all vectors $\mathbf{v},\mathbf{w}\in(0,\infty)^n$, where $\mathbf{v}^p$ and $\mathbf{w}^p$ are obtained by raising each coordinate to the power $p$, prove that $\|\mathbf{v}^p\|_2\|\mathbf{w}^p\|_2-\langle\mathbf{v}^p,\mathbf{w}^p\rangle\leq\|\mathbf{v}\|_2^p\|\mathbf{w}\|_2^p-\langle\mathbf{v},\mathbf{w}\rangle^p$.
references: - [Hadamard powers of Gram matrices and Generalized Cauchy-Schwarz inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12063) — arXiv — Nathaniel Johnston, Mohammad Sababheh

progress.label: Open · solution reported
progress.tldr: A 2026 preprint claims a full solution, but no independent assessment has verified it, so the conjecture remains unsettled.
progress.summary:
The problem asks whether a Hadamard-power refinement of Cauchy–Schwarz holds throughout the remaining real-parameter range and what its equality cases are. Johnston, Plosker, Torrance, and Varona established substantial integer-exponent and multilinear results in 2025, but left the noninteger case as a conjecture.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.10327)*

**Known results**

- The inequality fails for $p\in(1,2)$ and holds for integer $p\geq 1$.
- The 2025 preprint states Conjecture 5.1: validity for every noninteger $p\geq 2$.
- It also proves matrix, multilinear, and sum-of-squares extensions.


**October 2026 claimed proof**

Johnston and Sababheh’s preprint claims both conjectured inequalities, equality cases, and a multilinear extension. This is a claimed complete resolution, but the retrieved record supplies no independent mathematical assessment.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12063)*


Current status (as of October 2026): Integer-exponent cases and several extensions are established, while the full noninteger conjecture is only claimed in an unrefereed preprint and remains unverified.

*Caveats. The October 2026 resolution claim has not been independently assessed in the retrieved sources.*
